login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome. Sign in with your company account to continue.
login.hint: Use the same user name and password as your work computer. If you have a problem, contact the IT department.

hero.kicker: All your operations in one place
hero.title: An integrated management system
hero.customersSub: Customers and contracts in one place
hero.projectsSub: Projects and the workers assigned to each
hero.workersSub: A complete record of every worker and their movements
hero.approvalsSub: Structured approval stages and overdue follow-up
hero.reportsSub: Real-time indicators and reports for decisions

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-step verification
mfaSetup.intro: Two-step verification is required to protect your account. Scan the code with Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
mfaSetup.step1: Open your authenticator app and choose “Add account”.
mfaSetup.step2: Scan the code, or enter the key manually.
mfaSetup.step3: Enter the six-digit code shown in the app.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

company.title: Choose a company
company.intro: Your account can access more than one company. Choose the one you want to work in.

noCompany.title: No access
noCompany.intro: Your account is verified but is not linked to any company yet. Please contact the system administrator.

home.intro: You are signed in. Modules will appear here as they are released.
home.noPermissions: Your account belongs to this company but has no role yet. Please ask the company administrator for the access you need.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions granted to users in this company.
roles.name: Role
roles.builtInAdmin: A built-in role with every permission, including those of any new module. It cannot be changed.
roles.builtInReadOnly: A built-in role with every view permission and no changes. It cannot be changed.
roles.codeHint: Letters, digits and hyphens, for example: accountant-05

users.title: Users
users.intro: People who can access this company, and their roles.
users.addIntro: Enter the user's Active Directory name. They will join the company with no roles; you can then assign roles.
users.rolesIntro: Each role applies to all commercial registrations or to one only, for example: accountant for Care-Pro 05.
users.name: Name

legalEntities.title: Commercial registrations
legalEntities.intro: The company's commercial registrations. Each has its own financial statements and is the seller on tax invoices.
legalEntities.name: Name
legalEntities.codeHint: A short permanent code, for example: CP05
legalEntities.codeFixed: The code cannot change after creation because other records refer to it.
legalEntities.vatHint: Fifteen digits starting and ending with 3; required before issuing tax invoices.

branches.title: Branches
branches.intro: The company's branches and offices; each can belong to one commercial registration.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.codeHint: A short permanent code, for example: RUH

reference.title: Reference lists
reference.intro: Lists used across the system with permanent codes, shown in Arabic and English.
reference.empty: This list has no items yet.
reference.systemHint: A system item the logic relies on: its name can change, but it cannot be switched off.
reference.codeHint: A permanent code in Latin letters, for example: PHL
reference.codeFixed: The code cannot change after creation because saved data refers to it.

modules.title: System modules
modules.intro: The modules installed in this system and whether each is switched on.

Organization.name: Organization and settings
Organization.description: Companies, commercial registrations, branches, reference lists and settings.

Identity.name: Identity and access
Identity.description: Sign-in, two-step verification, users, roles and permissions.

Documents.name: Documents and notifications
Documents.description: Attachments on records, and notifications in the system and by email.

Workflow.name: Approvals
Workflow.description: Designable approval processes (stages, conditions, updates, notifications), my tasks, and internal requests.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.allowed: Accepted: PDF, PNG/JPG images, Word and Excel files, up to 20 MB.
attachments.confirmRemove: Remove the file “{{name}}”? It stays in the audit record.

approval.title: Approval
approval.requiredFieldHint: Required before approving; saved on the record.

tasks.title: My tasks
tasks.intro: Tasks waiting for your decision, and the ones you decided.
tasks.emptyPending: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
tasks.emptyDone: You have not decided anything yet.

requests.title: Internal requests
requests.intro: Internal requests and memos that go through the company's approval route.
requests.newIntro: Write the request, save it as a draft, then send it for approval.
requests.subject: Subject
requests.directManagerHint: Used by the approval process if it has a “direct manager” stage.
requests.returnedBecause: The request was returned for changes. Reason: {{reason}}
requests.sendHint: When sent, the matching approval process is chosen automatically by its conditions.

routes.title: Approval routes
routes.intro: Each document type has a route of stages. Every change is saved as a new version; documents in progress keep theirs.
routes.editHint: Each stage is decided by the first of its approvers; nobody approves a document they sent.

process.listIntro: Each screen has one or more approval processes: a start condition, stages, conditions and actions, published as versions.
process.name: Process
process.screenHint: The screen this process applies to.
process.priorityHint: With several processes on one screen, the lowest number whose start condition matches is used.
process.valid: The process is valid and ready to publish.
process.published: A new version was published and the process is active.
process.deactivated: The process is inactive; no new approvals start with it.
process.versionReadOnly: This is a published version and cannot be changed. Edit the draft and publish a new version.
process.startConditionHint: The process applies only to records matching this condition; leave it empty for all records.
process.stepsHint: Steps run in order. The process waits at each approval stage until it is decided, then continues.
process.noSteps: No steps yet. Add at least one approval stage.
process.requiredFieldsHint: The approver cannot approve until they are filled; they are saved on the record.
process.onApproveHint: Steps that run after approval; then the process continues with the next step.
process.onRejectHint: If empty, the process ends as rejected.
process.onReturnHint: If empty, the record goes back to its sender to change and send again.
process.elseHint: Steps that run when none of the conditions above is met.
process.nothingUpdatable: This screen does not let processes update any field.

typeHint.approval: A task for people to approve, reject or return
typeHint.condition: If / else if / else on field values
typeHint.update: Set a field or change the record's status
typeHint.stop: End the process as approved, rejected or canceled

process.tableHint: The screen's own record, or a table linked to it by a declared relation.
process.noRelatedTables: This screen has no related tables yet; the screen's own record is updated.

myApprovals.title: My submissions
myApprovals.intro: Everything you sent for approval, and where it stands.

monitor.title: Approval monitor
monitor.intro: Every approval in the company and its state, including those stopped by an error.

tracker.title: Approval stages
tracker.futureHint: Decided once the current stage is approved

crmSync.title: Sync from the old system
crmSync.intro: A read-only copy of the current CRM's data, and its nationalities and professions turned into the system's lists without duplicates.
crmSync.notConfigured: The CRM database connection is not configured (CrmSync:ConnectionString), so syncing is unavailable.
crmSync.otherCompany: The CRM's data belongs to the company “{{company}}”; switch to it to run the sync.
crmSync.readOnly: Read-only: nothing is ever written to the CRM database.
crmSync.every: Incremental sync runs automatically every {{minutes}} minutes.
crmSync.fullHint: A full sync reads every record again and marks records deleted from the CRM as deleted. It may take a few minutes.
crmSync.referencesIntro: Each country is matched to its international (ISO) code, and professions repeated in any spelling are merged into one. Records that are not real nationalities are left for review.
crmSync.syncFirst: Run the sync first so countries and professions are copied.
crmSync.unmappedTitle: Unmatched records ({{count}}): not real values; the field stays empty for whoever uses them until corrected
crmSync.name: Name
crmSync.crmRecords: CRM records merged into this item
crmSync.linkTitle: Link a record to a list item
crmSync.linkHint: The record “{{name}}” (used by {{count}} employees) will point to the item you choose; later imports keep this choice.
crmSync.mergeHint: All CRM records of “{{name}}” (used by {{count}} employees) move to the item you choose, and “{{name}}” is switched off. Later imports keep this merge.

workforce.search: Search by name, number, Iqama, passport or profession
workforce.removedInCrm: This employee was deleted in the old system; the file stays here for reference.
workforce.noSalaryPermission: You do not have permission to view salaries and allowances.

ids.duplicate: Previous or held by another person — review

workers.title: Workers

commercial.readOnly: View only at this stage: data is entered and edited in the old system and arrives here with every sync. Only customers and projects created from 1 January 2025 are brought over.

projects.title: Projects

projects.search: Search by code, project name, customer or project manager

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Customers, their projects and their workers, updated automatically from the old system.
customers.search: Search by name, number, CR, VAT number or mobile

prices.title: Price packages
prices.intro: A package for each profession and nationality, with service fee, salary, housing and transport; the delivery order picks it automatically from the worker's profession and nationality.
prices.search: Search by package number, project, customer, profession or nationality
prices.searchWorkers: Search by worker name or number, project, profession or nationality
prices.noPackages: No packages apply to this project yet.
prices.noPackagesYet: No packages yet. Add a package, or create one from "Suggestions from current prices".
prices.fromWorkerDefault: The work start has no price; this is the service price recorded on the worker.
prices.costPlusHint: This project's contract is Cost Plus: the worker's actual salary is invoiced, and the package sets the service fee, housing and transport on top of it. The salary here is for reference.
prices.professionHint: Current workers' professions are listed; type two letters to search all professions.
prices.feeHint: What the company charges on top of the salary.
prices.billable: A separate line on the customer's invoice
prices.validToHint: Leave empty for an open-ended package.
prices.suggestionsIntro: The most common price of each project, profession and nationality on the old system's current work starts. "Create package" opens a new package filled with these amounts to review and save.
prices.projectPackagesIntro: This project's packages, and the general packages that apply to its workers' professions.
prices.workersNote: Workers' prices from the old system (each worker's latest work start), compared with the package that applies to them today.

cards.noPackageFoot: No package for their profession and nationality
cards.missingFoot: No price in the old system
